items.name: gated-button
items.title: Gated button
items.description: A button that runs only an action the signed-in user may take: disabled with the reason, hidden, or offering to request approval.
items.docs: Wrap your app in PermDockProvider from permdock/react (https://permdock.com/docs/concepts/ui).

items.name: approval-request-dialog
items.title: Approval request dialog
items.description: For an action that returns approval-required: a dialog where the user adds a note and sends the request.
items.docs: Pass approvals to PermDockProvider so the request reaches your ApprovalStore (https://permdock.com/docs/adapters/approvals).

items.name: tenant-switcher
items.title: Tenant switcher
items.description: The organisations the user is a member of; picking one refreshes the snapshot for that tenant.

items.name: role-picker
items.title: Role picker
items.description: Only the roles the signed-in user may hand out in the active tenant.
items.docs: Save the change through a server action that calls decideRoleChange (https://permdock.com/docs/concepts/ownership).

items.name: custom-role-editor
items.title: Custom role editor
items.description: The permissions a custom role may include: only those the editor holds.
items.docs: Validate and store the role on the server (https://permdock.com/docs/concepts/custom-roles).

items.name: upgrade-prompt
items.title: Upgrade prompt
items.description: Shown when a plan would grant the action: names the plans and offers the upgrade.

items.name: gated-button-native
items.title: Gated button (React Native)
items.description: The gated button on React Native Reusables, with the reason as the accessibility hint.
items.docs: Wrap your app in PermDockProvider from permdock/react-native (https://permdock.com/docs/adapters/react-native).

items.name: upgrade-prompt-native
items.title: Upgrade prompt (React Native)
items.description: The upgrade prompt on React Native Reusables.
